pictures.label: Pictures
pictures.help: Up to {max} pictures in JPG, PNG or WebP, each up to 5 MB. The first is the main picture: it appears on cards, link previews and tickets. Drag the pictures or use the arrows to change the order.
pictures.full: An event can have up to {max} pictures. Remove one to add another.
pictures.none: No pictures yet. The cover style is used instead.
pictures.wrongType: {name} can't be used. Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
pictures.tooLarge: {name} is larger than 5 MB. Please resize it and try again.
pictures.wrongTypePlain: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
pictures.tooLargePlain: Pictures can be at most 5 MB.
pictures.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to add pictures.
pictures.failed: The pictures couldn't be saved. Please try again.
pictures.madeMain: This is now the main picture.

form.title: Create an event
form.intro: Add the details, then share one link so guests can register.

image.label: Event image
image.help: Shown on the event page and in Discover. JPG, PNG, or WebP, up to 5 MB. Tall or square works best.
image.none: No image? The cover style below is used instead.
image.wrongType: Use a JPG, PNG, or WebP image.
image.tooLarge: That image is larger than 5 MB. Please resize it and try again.

when.label: When
when.missing: Add both a start and an end date and time.

tickets.label: Tickets
tickets.pricesIn: Prices are in {currency}, your payout country's currency, in whole {currency}. A price of 0 makes that ticket free.
tickets.name: Ticket name
tickets.descriptionPlaceholder: What's included, such as a table for four near the stage
tickets.groupHelp: One purchase admits several people, such as a table.
tickets.admitsHint: From {min} to {max}. The quantity counts people, so 10 tables of 4 is 40.

options.label: Event options
options.visibilityHelp: Public events appear in Discover. Private events open only by link.
options.attendeeCountHelp: Let guests see how many people are going.
options.approvalHelp: You approve each registration before it is confirmed.
options.refundPolicyPlaceholder: e.g. Full refund up to 7 days before the event
options.paidRefundNote: Paid tickets are non-refundable except if the event is cancelled; guests see your policy next to that before they pay. You can still refund a ticket yourself from the guest list.

online.title: Online event
online.help: No venue; guests get the details from you.

location.regionChanged: This venue is in {region}, so the {label} was changed to match.
location.regionSet: {label} set to {region}, where the venue is.
location.mapsHelpWithMap: Not needed if the map above shows the right place. Add one to send guests to an exact entrance or pin.
location.mapsHelp: In Google Maps, open the venue, tap Share and copy the link. Guests use it for directions.

venue.label: Location / venue address
venue.searchPlaceholder: Search a venue, hotel, landmark or street, or type it
venue.plainPlaceholder: Venue name, address, or online link
venue.found: Found on the map: {address}. <button>Not this place?</button>
venue.suggestionsIn: Suggestions are in {region}. Pick one, or type the address and we'll find it on the map.
venue.pickOrType: Pick a suggestion, or type the address and we'll find it on the map.
venue.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again to search for venues.
venue.rateLimited: Too many searches at once. Wait a moment, or type the address yourself.
venue.unavailable: Venue suggestions aren't available right now. You can type the address yourself.
venue.noDetails: We kept the venue, but couldn't load its exact address. You can save it as it is.
venue.notFound: We couldn't find that on the map. Guests will see the address as you typed it.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.several: {country} has several time zones. Pick the venue from the search and it's set for you, or choose one here.
timeZone.searchLabel: Search a city or time zone
timeZone.searchPlaceholder: Type a city, e.g. Lagos or London
timeZone.sourceDevice: Your device's time zone. Guests see times in this zone.
timeZone.sourceLine: {source} Start and end times are in this zone.

fee.unavailable: The fee example isn't available right now.

validation.start: Add a start date and time.
validation.end: Add an end date and time.
validation.endAfterStart: The end must be after the start.

validation.notPaid: Paid tickets aren't available yet. Make every ticket free for now.
validation.price: The price for "{name}" must be a whole number of {currency}, like 5000.
validation.perBuyer: Choose a limit from 1 to 10 tickets per person.
validation.country: Choose a country from the list.
validation.groupSize: A group ticket "{name}" must admit 2 to 20 people.
validation.ticketDescription: The description for "{name}" can be up to {max} characters.
